newsitem.title: UK: Keller firm wins dock railway contract.
newsitem.headline: Keller firm wins dock railway contract.

text.p: British engineering company Keller Group Plc said on Monday that one of its firms had been awarded a 2.9 million stg contract to carry out part of the extension of the docklands light railway system in Lewisham in southeast London.
In a statement, Keller said the contract had been awarded to its UK subsidiary Keller Ltd by Mitsui Nishimatsu JV.
The contract involved specialist compensation and jet grouting and would enable control of ground settlement during tunnelling operations, the statement added.
